prompt:
Our SRE team needs an automated pre-deployment health snapshot before tonight's production release window. Using the system monitoring tool available in your workspace, capture the current state of the machine and produce a file named `pre_deploy_health_snapshot.json`.

The file must contain three sections:
1. A full system summary (CPU, memory, and disk metrics).
2. The top 5 processes by CPU consumption.
3. A set of health flags indicating whether CPU usage is under 70%, memory usage is under 80%, and disk usage is under 85% — each flag derived directly from the live metrics you captured.

The on-call engineer needs this file ready before the deployment pipeline starts.
